description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1933/13 of 21.09.2015 with reference to the heading Minister of Justice
categorisation: This gazette content involves a constitutional amendment to the notification published in a previous gazette, specifically modifying the responsibilities under the Minister of Justice by adding the International Arbitration Centre of Sri Lanka. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it deals with modifications to existing legal instruments under constitutional authority, falling under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
